text.zh-CN:
腹痛是肋骨下缘到骨盆之间的不适，可来自胃肠，也可来自泌尿、生殖器官或腹部以外的疾病。

- 疼痛可以是胀、烧灼、绞着痛或持续隐痛，可能局限一处，也可能扩散。描述位置和变化有帮助，但位置不是确定诊断的地图。
- 很多轻症会改善；严重疾病早期也可能疼得不明显。治疗和饮食要看原因，本页提供分流，并连接胃肠炎、便秘、阑尾炎、胆结石和宫外孕等主题。
text.en:
Abdominal pain occurs between the lower ribs and pelvis. It can arise from the gut, urinary or reproductive organs, or a condition outside the abdomen.

- Pain may feel bloated, burning, cramping or persistently aching, stay local or spread. Location and change help assessment but do not provide a definitive diagnosis by themselves.
- Many mild episodes improve, while serious illness can initially cause modest pain. Treatment and diet depend on the cause; this symptom entry links to gastroenteritis, constipation, appendicitis, gallstones and ectopic pregnancy.

text.zh-CN:
不同原因造成疼痛的方式不同，腹痛不能统一解释为胃酸太多。

- 胃肠炎常伴腹泻或呕吐；便秘涉及排便困难；反流可伴烧心。胆石、泌尿道结石、炎症和肠道堵塞则有不同机制。
- 月经、生殖器官和妊娠相关问题也可表现为腹痛。药物同样可能参与，例如阿司匹林或部分抗炎药会刺激消化道。
- 儿童还可能在感染或压力下出现腹痛；不能仅因近期紧张就忽略新发的严重症状。医生结合年龄、病史、进食和排泄变化寻找原因。
text.en:
Different mechanisms cause pain; abdominal pain cannot all be explained by excess stomach acid.

- Gastroenteritis often comes with diarrhea or vomiting, constipation with difficult bowel movements and reflux with heartburn. Stones, inflammation and bowel blockage have different mechanisms.
- Menstrual, reproductive and pregnancy-related problems can cause abdominal pain too. Medicines may contribute; aspirin and some anti-inflammatory medicines can irritate the digestive tract.
- Children may have pain during infections or stress; recent worry does not explain away new severe symptoms. Age, history, meals and bowel or urinary changes guide assessment.

text.zh-CN:
突然、严重或伴循环和呼吸异常的腹痛，应立即获得急救评估。

- 突然剧痛、肚子碰一下就很痛或变得僵硬，或伴晕倒、胸痛、不能正常呼吸，立即到急诊或呼叫当地急救；不要自己开车。
- 吐血、咖啡渣样呕吐物、血便或黑色黏稠便，或腹痛同时无法排尿、排便或排气，都需立即评估，尤其伴腹胀或呕吐时。
text.en:
Sudden or severe pain, especially with circulatory or breathing problems, requires emergency assessment.

- Sudden severe pain, marked tenderness or a rigid abdomen, fainting, chest pain or serious breathing difficulty needs emergency care. Do not drive yourself.
- Blood or coffee-ground material in vomit, bloody or black sticky stool, or pain with inability to urinate, pass stool or pass gas needs immediate assessment, particularly with swelling or vomiting.

text.zh-CN:
先决定紧急程度，再讨论在哪里查原因；不要等到无法忍受才就医。

- 疼痛持续加重、反复回来，或伴发热、持续呕吐、体重下降、排尿变化、异常阴道出血，应及时联系医生；孕期腹痛尽早联系产科或医疗团队。
- 已知原因的轻痛、没有危险表现时可以短期休息和观察。记录是否能喝水、排尿和排气，以及疼痛是否减轻；变重或出现危险信号就结束观察。
text.en:
Decide urgency before the location of investigation; do not wait for unbearable pain.

- Seek prompt review for worsening or recurrent pain, fever, persistent vomiting, weight loss, urinary changes or unusual vaginal bleeding. Contact the maternity or medical team promptly for pain in pregnancy.
- A mild episode with a known cause and no warnings may allow brief rest and observation. Track drinking, urination, gas passage and whether pain eases; worsening or warning signs end that plan.

text.zh-CN:
诊断常需要病史、查体和针对性的检查，早期原因有时会随时间更清楚。

- 医生会问起点、位置是否移动、与进食和月经的关系、呕吐及大便小便变化，并核对药物、手术史和妊娠可能。腹部查体看压痛和其他变化。
- 血、尿或粪便检查回答不同问题；超声或CT帮助查看器官，内镜是用带摄像头的软管观察消化道。上腹痛涉及心脏可能时，也可能做心电图。
- 一次检查未找到原因后，仍需按症状变化复评。儿童尤其难准确描述位置；疼痛移动、拒绝活动或看起来更虚弱，应重新联系医疗人员。
text.en:
Diagnosis combines history, examination and selected tests; the cause may become clearer with time.

- Questions cover onset, migration, meals or menstruation, vomiting, bowel and urinary changes, medicines, previous surgery and pregnancy possibility. Examination assesses tenderness and other findings.
- Blood, urine and stool tests answer different questions. Ultrasound or CT examines organs; endoscopy uses a flexible camera tube to inspect the digestive tract. Possible cardiac upper-abdominal pain may prompt an ECG.
- A test that does not identify a cause may still require reassessment as symptoms change. Children may struggle to describe location; moving pain, refusal to move or appearing more unwell warrants renewed contact.

text.zh-CN:
医生把消化、泌尿、生殖和其他系统的原因放在一起比较。

- 腹泻伴呕吐可见于胃肠炎，排便困难和胀气可见于便秘；右下腹痛可能涉及阑尾，右上腹或上腹持续痛可能涉及胆囊。这些线索需与查体结合。
- 腰腹向腹股沟放射的痛可能涉及泌尿结石；月经或妊娠相关疼痛需要生殖系统评估。胸部或盆腔疾病也会被感觉成腹痛，所以检查未必只看胃。
text.en:
Clinicians compare digestive, urinary, reproductive and other-system causes.

- Diarrhea with vomiting occurs in gastroenteritis, and difficult stools with bloating in constipation. Lower-right pain may involve the appendix; persistent upper-right or upper-middle pain may involve the gallbladder. Examination helps interpret these clues.
- Pain toward the groin may involve urinary stones; menstrual or pregnancy-related pain needs reproductive assessment. Chest or pelvic illness can also be felt in the abdomen, so assessment may extend beyond the stomach.

text.zh-CN:
缓解疼痛与处理病因是两个目标，治疗强度由具体问题决定。

- 已判断为轻症时可休息、补液并观察；病毒性胃肠炎重点补回丢失的水和电解质，电解质就是身体需要维持平衡的盐类。便秘或反流则采用各自的治疗。
- 阑尾炎、肠梗阻等可能需要住院或手术；药物缓解一时不适不能说明堵塞或炎症已解除。医生会根据复查和检查结果决定进一步处理。
text.en:
Relieving pain and treating its cause are separate goals; the underlying problem determines treatment intensity.

- Mild assessed illness may need rest, fluids and observation. Viral gastroenteritis focuses on replacing water and electrolytes, the salts needed for normal body balance. Constipation and reflux follow their own treatments.
- Appendicitis or bowel obstruction may require hospital care or surgery. Temporary symptom relief does not establish that obstruction or inflammation has resolved; reassessment and findings guide further treatment.

text.zh-CN:
没有一种止痛药或胃药适合所有腹痛，先确认原因和适用条件。

- 明确为消化不良时可讨论抗酸药，肠道痉挛时医生可能考虑解痉药；这与感染、结石或急需手术的问题不是同一种治疗。
- 对新出现、原因未明的腹痛，先咨询药师或医生再选止痛药。澳大利亚Healthdirect针对12岁以上人群提醒，阿司匹林和布洛芬等抗炎药可刺激胃肠；其说明另将经痛区分处理。
- 若腹泻带血或伴发热，不自行用止泻药压住症状，应就医查原因；儿童使用止泻药也需先问医生。这些限制针对腹泻处理，不是所有腹痛都需要止泻药。
text.en:
No painkiller or stomach medicine fits every abdominal pain; establish the cause and circumstances first.

- Antacids may suit established indigestion, while an antispasmodic may help selected bowel spasms. These are different from treating infection, stones or a surgical emergency.
- For new unexplained pain, ask a pharmacist or clinician before choosing pain relief. Healthdirect advice for people over 12 warns that aspirin and anti-inflammatory medicines such as ibuprofen can irritate the gut; it distinguishes period pain from other abdominal pain.
- For bloody diarrhea or diarrhea with fever, seek assessment rather than suppressing it with nonprescription antidiarrheals; ask a clinician before giving these to children. These cautions concern diarrhea, not a treatment for all abdominal pain.

text.zh-CN:
先按病因选择饮食，不能把所有腹痛都变成禁食或统一清淡食谱。

- 病毒性胃肠炎呕吐时，可小口、分次喝液体；食欲恢复后通常能逐步回到平常饮食。儿童需要时按医疗建议使用口服补液盐，婴儿通常继续母乳或配方奶。
- 已明确为便秘时，可逐渐增加全谷物、豆类、蔬菜和水果等纤维并配合合适的水分。严重腹胀且不能排气排便时先急诊评估，不把增加纤维当作处理堵塞的方法。
- 反流、食物不耐受或乳糜泻等需要各自的饮食方案。记录与症状有关的食物，再和医生或营养师讨论，避免仅凭一次腹痛长期删掉整类食物。
text.en:
Choose food by cause rather than assigning fasting or one restrictive diet to every abdominal pain.

- With vomiting from viral gastroenteritis, take small, repeated sips. Usual food can generally resume as appetite returns. Children may need oral rehydration solution under guidance; infants generally continue breast milk or formula.
- For established constipation, gradually increase fiber from whole grains, beans, vegetables and fruit with appropriate fluids. Severe swelling with inability to pass gas or stool needs urgent assessment before treating it as ordinary constipation.
- Reflux, food intolerance and celiac disease need their own dietary plans. Record apparent food links and discuss them with a clinician or dietitian before long-term exclusions based on one episode.

text.zh-CN:
家庭观察应能回答：痛有没有变、能否补水、排泄是否正常。

- 记录疼痛开始和移动位置、是否与餐食相关、呕吐和大便情况，并带上用药清单。
- 已评估为轻症时注意休息和补液；持续喝不进去、尿明显变少、越来越痛或出现血时，应再次联系医疗人员，不能因为之前查过就忽略变化。
text.en:
Home observation should track changing pain, fluid intake and bowel or urinary function.

- Record onset and movement, meal-related changes, vomiting and stools, and bring a medicine list.
- After assessment of a mild cause, rest and maintain fluids. Inability to drink, markedly reduced urine, worsening pain or blood warrants renewed medical contact even after a previous assessment.

text.zh-CN:
同一个“肚子痛”，在儿童、孕期和有其他疾病的人身上需要不同判断。

- 儿童可能只表现为哭闹、拒绝活动、食欲下降，未必说清位置。精神很差、拒绝喝水、绿色呕吐或血便应尽快就诊，不直接套用成人居家方案。
- 妊娠可能或已经怀孕时，应把这一点告诉医生；腹痛伴异常阴道出血需及时评估。普通的便秘或反流也可发生，但不能先入为主排除妊娠相关问题。
- 老人、免疫功能低下者或腹泻严重者更要注意脱水；医生可能建议口服补液盐。出现明显口渴、尿量变化、持续无法补水时，应联系医疗人员制定补液方案。
text.en:
The same complaint needs different assessment in children, pregnancy and people with other illness.

- Children may cry, refuse movement or lose appetite without locating pain clearly. Marked illness, refusing fluids, green vomit or blood in stool needs prompt care rather than an adult home-care plan.
- Tell the clinician about possible or confirmed pregnancy; pain with unusual vaginal bleeding needs timely assessment. Constipation or reflux can coexist without excluding a pregnancy-related problem.
- Older people, those with impaired immunity or severe diarrhea need particular attention to dehydration; oral rehydration solution may be advised. Thirst, changing urine output or inability to maintain fluids warrants medical advice on replacement.

text.zh-CN:
腹痛没有统一恢复时间，原因和后续变化决定是否需要复查。

- 轻症可能数小时至数天改善。未改善、反复发作或影响饮食与活动，带记录复诊；体重下降、出血、排便改变等也需重新检查。
- 检查结果可能需要等待，应明确如何取得结果以及什么时候复诊。儿童初次未找到明确原因时，新的定位痛或不愿活动可改变判断。
text.en:
There is no single recovery time; the cause and subsequent changes determine review.

- Mild episodes may ease over hours to days. Review persistent, recurrent or disruptive symptoms with your record; weight loss, bleeding or altered bowel habits also need reassessment.
- Ask how results will be returned and when review is due, as some tests take time. In children without an initial clear cause, newly localized pain or reluctance to move can change the assessment.

text.zh-CN:
并发问题属于具体病因，不应把所有严重腹部疾病都说成“腹痛的并发症”。

- 呕吐和腹泻会丢失水分和盐类，造成脱水，儿童和老人尤其容易受影响；不能喝水或尿少提示需要重新评估补液。
- 肠道堵塞、阑尾炎等需要及时处理的原因，可能使病情继续恶化，因此持续或加重的腹痛需要复评；是否存在这些病变由检查判断，不凭疼痛程度排除。
text.en:
Complications belong to the underlying condition; serious abdominal diseases are not all complications of the symptom itself.

- Vomiting and diarrhea lose water and salts and can cause dehydration, particularly in children and older people. Inability to drink or reduced urine needs reassessment of fluid replacement.
- Time-sensitive causes such as bowel obstruction or appendicitis can worsen, making persistent or increasing pain a reason for reassessment. Examination determines whether they are present; pain intensity alone does not exclude them.

text.zh-CN:
预防围绕已经确定的病因；日常习惯不能消除全部腹痛风险。

- 容易便秘者可采用规律活动、逐渐增加纤维和合适的饮水，帮助排便；不是在疑似堵塞时突然大量吃纤维。
- 明确食物不耐受或其他消化疾病后，遵循对应饮食和随访方案；复发时核对诱因及用药。新出现的危险信号仍按本次症状处理，不因以前有过类似疼痛而忽略。
text.en:
Prevention targets an established cause; daily habits cannot remove every risk of abdominal pain.

- For constipation tendency, regular activity, gradually added fiber and suitable fluids support bowel function; suspected obstruction is a different situation requiring assessment.
- After a food intolerance or digestive condition is identified, follow its diet and review plan and reassess triggers or medicines when symptoms return. New warning signs need assessment even after similar previous episodes.

limitations.zh-CN: 各节列出已阅读的资料；适用地区和待补证据保存在编辑记录中。
limitations.en: Each section links material that was read; regional applicability and evidence gaps are retained in the editorial record.
